title: KestrelCare Coverage Start Schedule: Waiting Period by Coverage Level
content:
KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts set a waiting period, in days and in miles, for a plan bought after the vehicle sale, and waive it for a plan sold with the vehicle. The figures are the same at every coverage level.

| Coverage level | Waiting period (days after the plan's sale date) | Waiting period (miles after the odometer at sale) | Plan sold with the vehicle starts at handover with no waiting period |
|---|---|---|---|
| KestrelCare Powertrain | 30 | 1000 | yes |
| KestrelCare Powertrain Plus | 30 | 1000 | yes |
| KestrelCare Silver | 30 | 1000 | yes |
| KestrelCare Gold | 30 | 1000 | yes |
| KestrelCare Platinum | 30 | 1000 | yes |
| KestrelCare Platinum Exclusionary | 30 | 1000 | yes |

## How the figures appear on the plan record

- For a plan sold with the vehicle (signed with the purchase agreement), the coverage start date recorded on the plan is the vehicle handover date.
- For a plan bought after the vehicle sale, the coverage start date recorded on the plan is the plan's sale date plus 30 days, and the coverage start odometer is the odometer at sale plus 1000 miles.

## Example (hypothetical plan bought after the vehicle sale)

A KestrelCare Gold plan is sold on 10 March with 41200 miles on the declarations page. The plan record shows a coverage start date of 9 April (10 March plus 30 days) and a coverage start odometer of 42200 (41200 plus 1000).
